category_name: This image captures a domestic scene with a cat resting on a bed in the foreground. There is a polished brown wooden floor and a cream-colored ceiling. In the foreground, a dark-furred cat sits atop a bed covered in a rumpled grey patterned blanket. A small red ball sits alone on the floor in the middle ground. Further back, there are a dark wooden couch, a chair, and a small potted plant next to a small light source. An open blue-framed glass door leads outdoors. A vertical blue curtain is also visible on the left side of the scene.
